summary: A second failure sends a customer back to find out whether the repair or an original defect caused it.
realLife: Washington HB 1483 (2025). The final report separates damage caused during independent repairs from failures attributable to design or manufacture.
inGame: needs: a device fails after an independent shop returns it.
gates: A device fails after an independent shop returns it.

turns.what: Evidence points to a mistake at the bench.
turns.pulledBy: The service record traces the damage to the repair.
turns.writesBack: The complaint goes to the shop.

turns.what: A factory fault comes to light after the repair.
turns.writesBack: The original defect becomes the basis of the claim.
